target.name: Annual national Cantril ladder mean
target.sourceRequired: Official intentionally public annual World Happiness Report map data; three-year averages forbidden

task: Bounded descriptive annual wellbeing demonstration in eight countries predetermined before source collection; no retuning after scores
interpretation: Limited preselected eight-country demonstration (USA, IND, DEU, GBR, BRA, JPN, ZAF, CHN); pooled results do not represent the full world panel.
Latest-vintage retrospective reconstruction; not real-time forecasts. Annual survey year is not release date.
Previously studied outcome periods are not untouched holdouts.
Conditional replay uses realized target-year drivers; these are conditional one-year reconstructions, not deployable forecasts.
Rolling forecasts use data dated at or before t-1, but source revisions can contain later information.
World Bank drivers differ from the WHR six-factor model and do not include same-survey social variables.
Results do not identify causal effects or validate post-AI scenarios.
Annual targets are public-chart transcriptions rounded to three decimals, not a bulk original Gallup annual data release; chart extraction and limited validation add measurement risk.

data.lastYear: latest official annual target year intersecting available source drivers

features.unit: log constant 2015 US dollars per capita
percent of labor force (modeled ILO estimate)

data.sourceFallbackRule: Do not score if official annual target cannot be acquired. No substitute rolling averages or unverified mirror.
data.missing: No interpolation, extrapolation, nearest future observation, zero fill, or cross-country fill. For forecasts ONLY, project observed drivers one year by half their immediately preceding annual change.
data.targetAcquisition: Read intentionally public annual rendered chart marks/axis ticks for original eight countries; parent verified annual selector and annual tooltips. Preserve SVG evidence and spot-check labels; no hidden application state or restricted data endpoints.

partition.cohort: Only the eight predetermined examples USA, IND, DEU, GBR, BRA, JPN, ZAF, CHN, subject to at least five complete annual target+three-feature rows in 2005–2016. These countries were chosen before source collection and outcome comparison. No selection based on errors or post2016 target levels.
partition.historicalTargets: Annual t-1 and t-2 targets permitted as explicitly observed lagged information. Each target-year target is withheld from its prediction.

modes.label: Conditional historical replay — actual annual drivers, frozen 2016 coefficients
modes.features: realized x_t permitted; no target y_t used

modes.label: Rolling one-year-ahead — projected drivers using data through t-1
modes.features: xhat_t = x_(t-1) + 0.5 * (x_(t-1)-x_(t-2)); no realized target-year features

masks.both: Target y_t observed; full y and three x available at t-1 and t-2; country eligible from initialTrain. All methods within mode evaluated on exactly identical rows.
masks.rollingAdditional: None: target-year x is not required or consulted.
masks.countryWeighting: Pooled metrics give each eligible country-year equal weight; macro country MAE also reported.
masks.methodAvailability: All four candidates and both baselines predict every included row. Prediction count equality asserted; no error-based exclusions.

estimation.ridgeObjective: sum squared residuals + 10 * sum squared coefficients on standardized columns; intercept unpenalized
estimation.featureScaling: Only training observations at or before per-row fitCutoff; each design column standardized by population SD, minimum1e-12.
estimation.countryOffsets: Mean(y)-mean(x) beta from complete country rows through fitCutoff, never from target-year ladder.
estimation.forecastClipping: Every final level prediction clipped to [0,10]; no feature clipping.

candidates.label: Change ridge
candidates.training: Consecutive complete triples through fitCutoff; target is annual y change. In rolling prediction x_t replaced by projected xhat_t.

candidates.label: Country offset + annual drivers
candidates.training: Within-country demean complete levels through fitCutoff; ridge pooled slopes. Rolling x_t is projected.

candidates.label: Country offset + half residual
candidates.formula: yhat_t = countryOffset + beta · x_t + 0.5 * [y_(t-1) - countryOffset - beta · x_(t-1)]
candidates.training: Same fitted country_offset coefficients; fixed half-residual carry.

candidates.label: Half change ridge / half persistence
candidates.training: Same fitted change_ridge coefficients; fixed half-change shrinkage.

metrics.primary: Level MAE on common mask in native ladder points; percent MAE reduction relative to persistence
secondary: change MAE using the same observed t-1 anchor (algebraically equal to level MAE at horizon1)
Pearson correlation of predicted and observed changes, null if constant
three-way direction accuracy using sign with 1e-9 numerical equality tolerance; not a substantively tuned deadband
nonzero observed-change direction accuracy and prediction direction coverage; persistence abstains on every move
matched-origin absolute-error wins/losses/ties against persistence and exact two-sided binomial sign-test p (descriptive; ignores dependence)
matched-origin three-way direction wins/losses/ties versus persistence and exact paired binomial p; persistence abstention makes this descriptive, not magnitude skill
metrics.uncertainty: No inferential generalization: repeated-country and serial dependence make naive p-values descriptive only.

execution.freeze: Commit protocol and model/tests before reading evaluation losses; scoring script verifies clean committed protocol/model and refuses overwrite of scoring receipt.
execution.preScoreValidation: Coverage/year/schema summaries allowed; no post2016 outcome statistics, fits, candidate losses or rankings before freeze.

registrationAmendments.reason: Official bulk annual target/predictor download unavailable; parent verified intentionally public country chart annual tooltip access. Restrict collection to original eight predetermined examples, chosen before outcomes. Candidate formulas, cutoffs, masks, hyperparameters unchanged.
